title.zh: 美国土安全部下令将DeepSeek产品排除在民用政府机构系统之外
title.en: 美国土安全部下令将DeepSeek产品排除在民用政府机构系统之外

current_state.zh: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.
current_state.en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek and related products, including third-party services incorporating DeepSeek, to be excluded from federal civilian agency procurement and removed from their IT systems.
